verdict.stance: Overweight / Defensive DFI-Funded Turkish Development Bank
verdict.summary: TSKB is Turkey's premier private-sector development bank (51.4% İşbank), funded primarily by long-term sovereign-guaranteed multilateral DFI lines (World Bank, EIB, KfW, AIIB) rather than hot retail deposits. H126 assets reached TRY 379.2bn with 18.3% Tier-1 and ~19% CAR.

positives: Long-dated multilateral DFI funding (>65% of liabilities) shields against Turkish deposit beta wars.
Exceptional capitalization: ~18.3% Tier-1 and 18.5%-19.4% CAR in H126.
>92% SDG-linked corporate/renewable project loan book backed by parent İşbank (51.4%) & Vakıfbank.
negatives: Wholesale-funded development bank model lacks zero-cost TRY demand deposit float.
FX-denominated corporate project loan book exposes asset quality to sharp TRY depreciation.
Turkish sovereign credit ceiling constrains standalone rating upside.

background.business_overview: Turkey's first privately owned development and investment bank focusing on green/sustainable capex lending.
background.asset_perimeter: TRY 275.6bn cash loan book (H126) across renewables, energy efficiency, and export industrials.
